claim_verdicts.software_construction_and_operation: Observed; see emitted instruments, predictions and separate operation receipts.

claims_not_tested: autonomous discovery of a new algorithm
improved learning rule across independent campaigns
classical.cost_scope: Measured local run work; authoring, included-model billing, external acceptance and economic costs remain unmeasured.

donor.learning_scope: Greedy coverage updates an ordering parameter of a supplied finite policy.

economics.billing: No new purchases or paid model API calls; actual included model/host billing and total authoring cost are unmeasured, not zero.
economics.cost_accounting: Report current-state construction costs and lineage costs separately. Donor search is charged to inherited-history arms and to the matched same-content contrast. No-history arm does not receive or pay for donor history. Verification, acquisition, failed attempts and resume costs are recorded; unmetered authoring effort remains unknown.
economics.funding_arrangement: No financial arrangement executed. Existing authorized computation and public data only.
economics.future_dependency: External laboratory validation, participation and any commercial delivery would need their own evidence and authorization.

successor.cohort_scope: One source-ordered calibration/test split of a publicly known assay.
successor.task: whole-cell instances from measured DNA plus actin

evidence_role: Exposed registered comparison reproduced; not new holdout confirmation or recovery of the earlier missing full package.

classical.scope: Reproduction and independent rescoring of exposed registered data; not fresh scientific confirmation or independent historical timing evidence.

classical.independence: Separate reference decoder, scorer, coverage/selection verifier. Classical prediction replay uses the frozen generator. Common project authorship; no external laboratory certification.
limits: Runtime and historical execution are recorded claims, not recoverable from hashes.
Neural saved-mask scores are verified; generating-model inference is separately operated.
No biological, clinical, commercial, general learning or novel task-population claim is established.

incumbent.scope: Verifies scores, masks, source identity, border policy, coverage and reported verdicts. It does not establish model generation from hashes; retain the separately observed source-matched model operation/replay.

saved_neural_predictions.independence: Frozen separate reference decoder/scorer and complete saved-mask audit. Common project authorship; no external laboratory certification.
limits: No neural inference or classical replay is executed by this audit.
Invocation and postrun receipts are separately bound; hashes do not prove historical model execution or elapsed time.
No new biological, clinical, commercial or unseen-data confirmation claim is established.

observed_run_reconciliation.scope: Recorded invocation, output and postrun-receipt reconciliation. No new inference; hashes do not independently prove historical model execution or elapsed time.

measured_cost_boundaries.classical_interruption_flag_scope: Recorded run-state attempts only. False means the retained ledger records no interrupted or orphaned attempt; it does not prove absence of unrecorded execution.
measured_cost_boundaries.scope: Separate observed process boundaries. Setup, acquisition, rejected/superseded checking, operation and other receipts are retained individually. Nested command and session costs overlap; elapsed times from parallel work must not be added as project duration. Missing historical costs, additional work or cost associated with unresolved residual-file provenance, authoring, upstream training and actual host/model billing are unknown, not zero.

pretrained_practical_alternative.comparison_role: Pretrained practical alternative with different learned stock; outside the six equal-content causal arms.
pretrained_practical_alternative.comparison_selection_timing: The pretrained comparison was selected after classical source outcomes. Its RGB observation adapter was separately registered after classical calibration outcomes and RGB-format inspection, before any target-test prediction/score or neural inference. Model weights, channels, numerical hyperparameters and gates were unchanged.
pretrained_practical_alternative.cost_scope: Measured process CPU/wall and published model bytes. Upstream training, authoring, development, host/inference billing and unrecorded interruption intervals are unknown, not zero. No financial transactions.

border_policy.cells: Exclude complete predicted objects touching the image frame, then relabel, as in the primary BBBC007 protocol.
border_policy.nuclei: Keep border objects, as in the primary BBBC039 protocol.

pretrained_practical_alternative.rights_scope: Research operation only. Cellpose code is BSD-3-Clause; model-card metadata says BSD-3-Clause, its documented training data are CC-BY-NC, and DINOv3 has separate custom terms. Commercial permissions are not established. No upstream source or weights redistributed.

classical_projection.residual_cause: UNKNOWN; no attribution is inferred from duplicate bytes.

cost_boundaries.timing_rule: Receipt boundaries overlap. Do not add nested command and session CPU totals or parallel wall times as project duration.

provenance.evidence_role: New reproduction of an already exposed registered comparison. Not recovered historical result bytes or a fresh confirmation.

historical_availability.focused_failure_replays: New focused executions of preserved source snapshots; not the absent original full runs.

preservation.excluded: Public input archives/raw DNA input pixels, third-party weights/upstream package archives and environments, private correspondence drafts, and temporary editorial/browser artifacts.
preservation.exclusion_rule: Identified public upstream inputs are retrieved separately. No reported scientific prediction, adverse result or measured cost is removed.
preservation.included: All complete producer outputs, independent check receipts, original raw rejection, explicit projection and residual bytes, setup attempts, focused failures, logs and recovery/operator evidence.

source.final_publication_source_identity: Bound separately by PUBLICATION.json and the qualified Git commit; no circular self-commit claim is made here.

verification.actual_neural_execution: Separate observed complete 116-field invocation with source/runtime/input bindings.
verification.candidate_and_downloaded_package_operati: Performed separately after packaging. A public OPERATION_RECEIPT.json is added to the release only after actual downloaded-source operation passes; it is not inferred from this scientific archive.
verification.checker_repair: The first saved-neural audit rejected an incorrect key path in the additive checker: the pinned loading record is nested at preflight.loading. Prior checker/driver source and the failed audit are retained. The corrected checker is bound to PROJECTED_CLASSICAL_INDEPENDENT_CHECK-002.json and INCUMBENT_INDEPENDENT_CHECK.json, including a new full classical replay. Registered producers, acceptance criteria, model and predictions are unchanged.
verification.classical: Full independent reference decoding/rescoring and frozen classical generator replay; 2632 distinct predictions and 196 saved fields.
verification.neural: All 116 saved fields independently rescored from original references; this audit does not rerun inference.
verification.recovery_and_raw_operator: Observed completed-run idempotent resume and one first-official-test raw-image operation are separately recorded.
verification.retained_orchestration_drivers: These preserve the original observed layout and command paths. Use construction/check.py for portable scientific verification of an extracted archive, and new absolute work paths for a new execution.
verification.review_independence: Separate implementations and preparation roles with common project authorship; not external peer review or laboratory certification.
